_about: Grammar words of question interpretation (plan 08 T2): request, filler, coordinator, punctuation, particle,
marker, negation, exclusion, relation, tail-noun, X-byeol and unit words, one place for every class. A word is
compared as an index key (NFKC, lower case, no spaces) unless a class says otherwise. Derived sets are built only
in interpret/lexicon.py. General Korean grammar; not tuned to questions, cases or answers. Condition vocabulary
(basis axes, calc patterns, period words) stays in condition_words.json; model-step labels and option texts stay
in model_step_words.json; table-selection words stay in evidence_words.json.

script._about: Character ranges (regular-expression class bodies) of the scripts the rules read: Hangul syllables, Hangul jamo and compatibility jamo, and the other letters of a word.

_about: Request and predicate words taken off the end of a clause (2-5: only known words are removed, an unknown noun
stays). forms.final: complete asking predicates (a request that ends; 'A를 보여줄래, B는 빼줘' ends its clause at
the comma); the predicate of 'X 필요 없어' is the exclusion's existence entry (exclusion.existence), never a
request; forms.noun: display and filler nouns of a request. polite_endings: a final form with one of these
after it is final too ('보여줘요'; plan 08 step 4: the forms replace the old 'words x final endings' rule).

clause_end_request._about: Request verbs with a connective ending that end a clause and start another (보여주고).

connective._about: A predicate stem with a connective ending ends a clause (plan 04, 2-4: item clause and other clauses); the endings also end a clause of the attribution rules.

_about: words: filler words that are neither names nor leftover words (2-3 check 5, user 10/18). base_word: the lone
basis word, a filler except right after a period ('2015년 기준' is a base year and stays an unknown word).
model_ignorable: request and filler words (or their stems) a leftover word the model read as such must be
(model_verify V-cover).
Words and particles that join list items. words: list words written apart (및, 그리고). particles: joiner
particles written against an item; after_name_only: the ones read as a joiner only on a name, condition or
qualifier token (on a bare word only 와/과 join, old find_lists). and_word: the list word inside and-names of
the catalog and the 'W 및 X' merge. conjunctive: the list words that join (및, 그리고), not choose (또는, 혹은).
list_joiners: the joiner particles a question writes in place of the and-word or a list mark inside one
catalog name ('A 및 B', 'A·B' -> 'A과 B', 'A와 B'; plan 14 I8 joiner keys of catalog/names.py).
Marks after NFKC (full-width forms read as these). sentence_end ends a clause; separators cut a list; dots are
the middle dots of a list; open/close are brackets; other: other marks of the tokenizer. axis_list adds the
slash between listed X-byeol axes; trim: marks trimmed off a requirement quote; name_split: marks between the
words of a table name (catalog reading); list_dots_norm: the middle dots of the 2.2 list rules (normalised text); number_marks: marks inside a number.
Particles and endings by kind. endings: particles and verb endings cut off a word before it is looked up (and
after a name); name_boundary: endings that may follow a catalog name inside one written word (catalog/spans.py);
topic, object, genitive, complement, designate (restrictive: 'X만', 'X에만'), subject, aux (는/도 between a verb
stem ending and its negation: '하지는 말고'); phrase_end_endings: endings that close a phrase besides the case
particles; list_tail, token_tail: particles after the last item of a 2.2 list and after a word of a phrase;
marker: particles after a relation, function or display word; phrase_closing: particles that end the words
before a shared head ('X A와 B'); genitive_of: the genitive particle itself.
subject: 이
가

verb_endings._about: modifier: adnominal verb endings (an unknown verb with one right before a condition or name modifies it: '보유한 X별'); adnominal_final: the last syllable of an adnominal verb form ('늘어난', '가진') that continues a noun phrase in the attribution rules.

_about: plan 05 B: distributive markers split a requirement per listed X-byeol axis; simultaneous markers keep one
requirement over them. common: words that make a tail condition common (2-4 rule 5, with the two lists
above). measure_skip: words that are no noun word of an item (2.7 indicator words).

divide._about: Dividing verbs ('A와 B를 나눠'), their adnominal form ('A와 B를 나눈 N'), the adverbs allowed between the listed axes and the verb, and the ending that closes the phrase N of 'N에서 A와 B를 나누어'.

_about: words: phrase negation ('A가 아니라 B', 'A 말고 B'). basis: the negation read after a basis word (old q4:
particles, then one of the words; a word may hold a space). designation: words that make a designation
clause ambiguous (2-4 rule 1).
Exclusion predicates (2.2, plan 05 E): verbs in regular-expression alternation order (the order decides
overlaps), the particles before them, the ending and verbs that negate them ('제외하지 말고': negated_ending
+ negated_by), the suffix 이외, the source and tails of a calculation definition in brackets and the
complement hints. existence: the existence-negation predicate ('X는 필요 없어', '필요가 없어',
'필요는 없어'): a noun of 'nouns', one of 'particles' or none, then the negative stem; 'forms' are its
written forms, read by the request words as no request (one reading of the predicate's polarity).
Relation, function and display words of 2.2 as word patterns: regex, value, and the word boundaries required
at the start and the end ('word': no letter before / after but a marker particle). combine: combining verbs
and the relation they make; share: share verbs; list_separators: relation words that also cut a list ('대비').
General nouns written right after a condition or value. basis: after a basis value ('명목 금액'): read as part
of that value; topic_lead: between a condition and the next topic head ('분기 기준으로 B는'); negation: between
a basis word and its negation ('기준이 아니라'); list_boundary: words before a list that do not modify it.

byeol._about: The X-byeol mark ('X별'), the particles it may take, and the frequency heads whose X-byeol is a frequency.

derived_names._about: Plan 09 P1: tail words of a table name that a question may leave out ('가상물가지수' read from '가상물가'); the catalog name index adds the name without the tail as a derived name (never exact).

units._about: Unit words of 2.2: scales, money units and their currency, the unit word, percent words.
